preconditions.description: The number of knitting needles in the sculpture is between 1 and 50000, inclusive.
The coordinates of each triple are all less than 1000 and greater than or equal to 1.

postconditions.expression: output_line_1 in {'True closed chains', 'No true closed chains'}
postconditions.description: The first output line indicates the presence of a true closed chain.

postconditions.expression: output_line_2 in {'Floor closed chains', 'No floor closed chains'}
postconditions.description: The second output line indicates the presence of a floor closed chain.

invariants.expression: all(len(needle) == 2 and all(isinstance(coord, tuple) and len(coord) == 3 for coord in needle) for needle in needles)
invariants.description: Each needle is represented by a set of two triples, each containing three integers.

invariants.expression: all(all(isinstance(coord, int) and 1 <= coord < 1000 for coord in triple) for triple in [coord for needle in needles for coord in needle])
invariants.description: Each coordinate in a triple is an integer between 1 and 999, inclusive.

invariants.expression: all(needle[0] != needle[1] for needle in needles)
invariants.description: No two coordinates in a needle are the same.
